# Upstream source

The three files in `src/` are preserved from `justjake/fujimod`, commit
`1de936e9b1ca738b04ad5132c727288ddd5eb2ae`, `crates/firmware/src/`.
The Cargo manifest is adapted to remove the upstream workspace coupling.
Their original authorship and rights are retained. The Fuji Boost root MIT
license does not grant rights to these third-party files. No project-wide
upstream license was identified during the research; clarify authorization
before distributing a derivative containing these files.

Source: https://github.com/justjake/fujimod/tree/1de936e9b1ca738b04ad5132c727288ddd5eb2ae/crates/firmware
